run_status: REAL-CALL WATCH ON (David, 2026-11-14 ~12:02 EST: account funded, 'go ahead'). Desk relays guarded calls to David; David taps buy in his own Poly app; fill reports come back to the desk to seal. Watch runs until David says stop or a day stop hits.

rules.reserve_law: never spend an engine whole bank; savings plus two more rounds always remain; wins banked at settlement, enter B next day; tighten when losing, NEVER loosen mid-day because of winnings
rules.stake_rule: s = round down to 10c of 10% x day-start settled bank B, floored at $0.50; set once at day start, never changed mid-day
rules.savings_lock: L = $1.00 + 30% x max(0, all-time net profit above the starting $5.00); ratchets up only; bank <= L pauses the engine
rules.fire_test: a play fires only if uncommitted bank after committing s is >= L + 2s
